scope: Current source-backed catalogue after the precision-origin additions. Counts are published side-specific records, not independent in-game verification.
method: Normalize every generated per-map JSON and merge complete archived photo guides by source+side. Typed destinations use current splitUtilityDestinations semantics separately per floor/side/utility. Explicit spawn families share only the same exact normalized target, area and coverage qualifier; unrelated names and personal guides stay separate. Distinct origin labels retain source numbers and do not imply measured feet coordinates.
originSelectionPolicy: Every source recipe for a chosen destination remains available. Nearby source-point hit areas share a real anchor and open visual recipe choices rather than dropping recipes or moving standing coordinates. The old four-origin cap is removed after selection.
